title.value: Nonlinear chance-constrained problems with applications to hydro scheduling
title.justification: The title of the paper as provided in the beginning of the text.
title.quote: Nonlinear chance-constrained problems with applications to hydro scheduling

analysis.description: The paper presents a Branch-and-Cut algorithm for solving a class of nonlinear chance-constrained mathematical optimization problems, particularly applied to hydro scheduling. The method is based on an implicit Benders decomposition scheme designed to manage deterministic convex mixed-integer nonlinear programming problems that become complex as scenarios increase. The algorithm is evaluated using data from Greek hydroplants, demonstrating improved performance compared to general-purpose solvers and showing better scalability with the number of scenarios.

type.justification: The paper primarily presents and analyzes a new algorithmic approach (Branch-and-Cut algorithm) for nonlinear chance-constrained problems, rather than focusing on empirical experiments.
